reply.text:
Mostly a comfort and confidence call. Sleeves keep the joint warm and some people feel a bit more snappy out of the hole, but they don't make you stronger, and they aren't something you need. If you squat fine without them, skip them. If you like how they feel, wear them on your working sets and leave them off for warm-ups.

If the question is really about knee pain or something feeling off, that's one for a doctor or physio, not me. I can keep building your squat work around whatever they clear.
